archetypes.name: stale-coordinates
archetypes.rationale: Plan cites many exact line numbers in existing files that may have shifted since research; stale coordinates cause wrong-site edits or broken structural-test patches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify every specific line number, section anchor, and tilde-approximate location cited in the plan against the current content of the named files: lines 397–402, 403, 404–405, 407, 409, 412–415 in `scripts/test-design-structure.sh`; the `~1413` Plan-helper-contracts bullet region in `skills/design/SKILL.md`; and the `~1371+` harness-sibling exclusion block in `agent-lint.toml`. Check whether the surrounding context the plan describes (e.g. existing `$APPROVAL_MD` / `$DISCUSSION_MD` bindings, existing `snapshot` grep lines, existing thin-adapter exclusion entries) actually appears at those coordinates. Flag any coordinate that is off by more than a few lines or whose described context does not match what is actually there. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shard-registration
archetypes.rationale: Plan asserts test-trailer-awk.sh can be invoke-only with no standalone Makefile target or shard entry, relying solely on the thin-adapter precedent; this assumption needs verification against the actual shard-coverage enforcement rules.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the actual shard-coverage enforcement mechanism in the repo: locate the Makefile targets and shard-registration table (likely under `scripts/` or the Makefile), find how existing invoke-only thin-adapter test scripts (`test-trailer-dedup.sh`, `test-trailer-has-any.sh`, `test-trailer-validate.sh`) are treated, and determine whether `make test-harness-shards-coverage` or an equivalent check would flag a new `test-trailer-awk.sh` that has no standalone entry. The plan's failure-mode section acknowledges the risk but does not commit to a concrete mitigation; evaluate whether the stated precedent actually holds under the current enforcement rules or whether the plan needs to add a target and shard entry. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: agent-lint-partition
archetypes.rationale: Plan partitions six new .md files across two distinct agent-lint compliance paths (SKILL.md Sibling/harness-contract citations vs. agent-lint.toml stub-only exclusions); an incorrect partition causes S030 lint failures or spurious exclusions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the actual agent-lint S030 rule definition and the existing harness-sibling exclusion block in `agent-lint.toml` (~1371+) to verify the plan's stated partition: `lib-plan-optional-trailers.md`, `test-trailer-helpers.md`, and `test-trailer-awk.md` are meant to be cited from SKILL.md `Sibling:` / harness-contract bullets (not excluded), while `test-trailer-dedup.md`, `test-trailer-has-any.md`, and `test-trailer-validate.md` are stub-only adapters meant for the exclusion list. Check whether the exclusion-list format and the existing entries match the plan's description, and whether the three files targeted for SKILL.md citation actually need to appear under a specific Plan-helper-contracts list entry or some other anchor. Flag any file that the plan places in the wrong compliance path or whose required anchor location is misdescribed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
